{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert the 'revenue' column from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders: values exactly 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders from completed orders (if any)
completed_no_qa = completed_orders[~completed_orders.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue_cleaned = completed_no_qa['revenue'].mean()

# Print the results
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_cleaned:.2f}")"}
